title: NIKATRU bundle contract
description: The bundle vocabulary: how a bundle grant came to exist, and what kinds of product a bundle may span. Authored in contracts/entitlement/bundle.js and derived into bundle.json by generate-bundle.mjs; this schema is what makes the JSON copy checkable by something other than a reader. The SQL half is services/platform/migrations/0009_bundle_grants.sql section B, and tooling/ci/assert-entitlement-contract.mjs limb 9 holds the two sets equal in both directions.

bundleSources.description: How a bundle grant came to exist. [ADR 057] §3 — the set is decided in the migration that creates it or never, because a grant whose provenance was not written at insert time is unclassifiable forever. Must equal the rows seeded by 0009_bundle_grants.sql section B.

source.description: The stored value. snake_case, because it is written into a database column and read back by more than one runtime.

requiresReceipt.description: Whether a grant from this source is only legitimate with a VERIFIED server-side receipt behind it. The machine-readable half of 'no entitlement without a verified receipt': a guard READS which sources are exempt instead of a reviewer remembering. A copy that keeps every name and flips one flag turns a paid rail into one that mints grants from nothing, and it looks correct in a diff.

productKinds.description: A product is an app, an extension, a script, a bundle, a service or a site, which is the single property that keeps adding a category a DATA change rather than a schema change. A bundle is a product made OF products: it is never counted live and is never a member.

productRegisters.description: Where each kind's slugs are published, as data — so the availability derivation and its Worker twin read the same list instead of two hand-written ones. `register: null` records a category that is DECLARED and has no register yet, which is a different fact from a category nobody thought about.

register.description: Repo-relative path to the JSON array of {slug, status} rows, or null when the category ships nothing yet.

slugField.description: The row field that is the product's slug, when it is not `slug`. The bundle register's rows carry `featureSet`.

productStatuses.description: The two values tooling/ci/assert-catalog-contract.mjs permits. Restated here because the bundle's purchasable gate is a predicate over them; a third spelling is not a new state, it is a row no guard grades.

minLiveProductsForBundle.description: The minimum number of LIVE products that makes a bundle an offer at all. Two. One live product plus a 'bundle' is a second SKU for one thing, and selling it as 'everything we make' would be a false statement on the day it was made. A named constant rather than a literal in the derivation, so the number can be asserted rather than read.
